title: Have you ... yet?
description: A picture-based lesson on the present perfect tense with 'yet'. Four illustrations each introduce a 'Have you ... yet? / When did ...?' question-and-answer pair (met Mrs. Jones, the boss left, had breakfast, found her pen). A table of irregular verbs (buy, find, get, have, hear, leave, lose, make, meet, send, sweep, tell) reinforces the past and past-participle forms. Written exercises A (write questions and negative answers from past-simple sentences) and B (write 'Have you ... yet?' questions with answers and when-questions) are transcribed from the textbook. Workbook practice covers completing 'Has he finished it yet?' dialogues and personal questions. Grammar exercises practise giving present-perfect replies to imperatives and answering 'and' questions partially.
answer_note: Written exercise A (write questions and negative answers) 6 items are suggested model answers following the printed example pattern. Written exercise B (write questions and answers) 10 items are suggested model answers following the printed example pattern. Workbook practice A ('Has he finished it yet?' conversations) item 1 is a printed example; item 2 is taken from the supplied Lesson 88 key (img/key-085-090.jpg); items 3-5 are suggested model answers following the model box. Workbook practice B (about you) 6 items are open-ended personal questions with suggested model answers. Grammar I (give correct replies) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are suggested model answers following the example (the grammar key pages in the PDF cover only Lesson 87). Grammar II (answer the questions) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are suggested model answers following the example. No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen and answer the questions.
听录音并回答问题。
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer the questions in the four pictures.

lesson.text:
Have you met Mrs. Jones yet?
Yes, I have.
When did you meet her?
I met her two weeks ago.
lesson.translation: 第1幅：你见过琼斯太太了吗？是的，我见过。你什么时候见到她的？我两周前见到的她。

lesson.text:
Has the boss left yet?
Yes, he has.
When did he leave?
He left ten minutes ago.
lesson.translation: 第2幅：老板走了吗？是的，他走了。他什么时候走的？他十分钟前走的。

lesson.text:
Have you had breakfast yet?
Yes, we have.
When did you have it?
We had it at half past seven.
lesson.translation: 第3幅：你们吃过早饭了吗？是的，我们吃了。你们什么时候吃的？我们七点半吃的。

lesson.text:
Has she found her pen yet?
Yes, she has.
When did she find it?
She found it an hour ago.
lesson.translation: 第4幅：她找到她的钢笔了吗？是的，她找到了。她什么时候找到的？她一小时前找到的。

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction:
Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

Four pictures each show a 'Have you ... yet?' question and its follow-up when-question. 四幅图片各展示一个“Have you ... yet?”问题及其后续的时间问题。
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer each question in the four pictures.

questions.prompt: 1. Have you met Mrs. Jones yet? When did you meet her?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I met her two weeks ago.

questions.prompt: 2. Has the boss left yet? When did he leave?
questions.answer: Yes, he has. He left ten minutes ago.

questions.prompt: 3. Have you had breakfast yet? When did you have it?
questions.answer: Yes, we have. We had it at half past seven.

questions.prompt: 4. Has she found her pen yet? When did she find it?
questions.answer: Yes, she has. She found it an hour ago.

lesson.text:
Study these verbs.
记住以下不规则动词的过去式和过去分词。

buy — bought — bought
find — found — found
get — got — got
have — had — had
hear — heard — heard
leave — left — left
lose — lost — lost
make — made — made
meet — met — met
send — sent — sent
sweep — swept — swept
tell — told — told
lesson.translation: Irregular verbs with their past and past-participle forms.

lesson.title: Written exercises A — Write questions and answers
lesson.instruction:
Write questions and answers. 模仿例句就以下句子提问，并作出否定的回答。

Example:
He bought a house last year.
QUESTION: Did he buy a house last year?
NEGATIVE: He didn't buy a house last year.
lesson.translation: For each sentence write a past-simple question and a negative answer, following the example.
lesson.context: Suggested model answers following the printed example pattern.

questions.prompt: 1. He found his pen a minute ago.
questions.answer:
QUESTION: Did he find his pen a minute ago?
NEGATIVE: He didn't find his pen a minute ago.

questions.prompt: 2. He got a new television last week.
questions.answer:
QUESTION: Did he get a new television last week?
NEGATIVE: He didn't get a new television last week.

questions.prompt: 3. We heard the news on the radio.
questions.answer:
QUESTION: Did you hear the news on the radio?
NEGATIVE: We didn't hear the news on the radio.

questions.prompt: 4. They left this morning.
questions.answer:
QUESTION: Did they leave this morning?
NEGATIVE: They didn't leave this morning.

questions.prompt: 5. He lost his umbrella yesterday.
questions.answer:
QUESTION: Did he lose his umbrella yesterday?
NEGATIVE: He didn't lose his umbrella yesterday.

questions.prompt: 6. I swept the floor this morning.
questions.answer:
QUESTION: Did you sweep the floor this morning?
NEGATIVE: I didn't sweep the floor this morning.

lesson.title: Written exercises B — Write questions and answers
lesson.instruction:
Write questions and answers. 模仿例句提问并回答。

Example:
they / buy a new house / two weeks ago
Have they bought a new house yet?
Yes, they have already bought a new house.
When did they buy a new house?
They bought a new house two weeks ago.
lesson.translation: For each set of prompts write a 'Have you ... yet?' question with a yes answer and a when-question with a past-simple answer, following the example.
lesson.context: Suggested model answers following the printed example pattern.

questions.prompt: 1. he / meet Mrs. Jones / two weeks ago
questions.answer:
Has he met Mrs. Jones yet?
Yes, he has already met Mrs. Jones.
When did he meet Mrs. Jones?
He met Mrs. Jones two weeks ago.

questions.prompt: 2. the boss / leave / ten minutes ago
questions.answer:
Has the boss left yet?
Yes, he has already left.
When did the boss leave?
He left ten minutes ago.

questions.prompt: 3. he / have breakfast / at half past seven
questions.answer:
Has he had breakfast yet?
Yes, he has already had breakfast.
When did he have it?
He had it at half past seven.

questions.prompt: 4. she / find her pen / an hour ago
questions.answer:
Has she found her pen yet?
Yes, she has already found her pen.
When did she find it?
She found it an hour ago.

questions.prompt: 5. he / get a television / two weeks ago
questions.answer:
Has he got a television yet?
Yes, he has already got a television.
When did he get a television?
He got a television two weeks ago.

questions.prompt: 6. she / hear the news / yesterday
questions.answer:
Has she heard the news yet?
Yes, she has already heard the news.
When did she hear the news?
She heard it yesterday.

questions.prompt: 7. she / make the bed / this morning
questions.answer:
Has she made the bed yet?
Yes, she has already made the bed.
When did she make the bed?
She made it this morning.

questions.prompt: 8. he / send the letter / the day before yesterday
questions.answer:
Has he sent the letter yet?
Yes, he has already sent the letter.
When did he send the letter?
He sent it the day before yesterday.

questions.prompt: 9. she / sweep the floor / yesterday morning
questions.answer:
Has she swept the floor yet?
Yes, she has already swept the floor.
When did she sweep the floor?
She swept it yesterday morning.

questions.prompt: 10. she / tell him the truth / last night
questions.answer:
Has she told him the truth yet?
Yes, she has already told him the truth.
When did she tell him the truth?
She told him the truth last night.

practice.title: A — Has he finished it yet?
practice.instruction:
Look at this. 请看下表。

A: Has Tom finished the job yet?  B: Yes, he has. He's / He has just finished it.
or Yes, he has. He finished it half an hour ago.
or No, he hasn't finished it yet.

Write conversations with these prompts. 根据提示完成以下对话。
practice.translation: Write a short conversation (question + answer) for each prompt, following the model box.
practice.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Item 2 is taken from the supplied Lesson 88 key (img/key-085-090.jpg). Items 3-5 are suggested model answers following the model box.

questions.prompt: 1. you / repair my watch yet? / Yes / yesterday evening
questions.answer: Have you repaired my watch yet? / Yes, I have. I repaired it yesterday evening.

questions.prompt: 2. they / see 'Star Wars' yet? / No / not yet
questions.answer: Have they seen 'Star Wars' yet? / No, they haven't seen it yet.

questions.prompt: 3. she / find a new job yet? / Yes / a week ago
questions.answer: Has she found a new job yet? / Yes, she has. She found it a week ago.

questions.prompt: 4. he / meet your family yet? / Yes / just
questions.answer: Has he met your family yet? / Yes, he has. He's just met them.

questions.prompt: 5. you / hear the news about Ken yet? / Yes / yesterday
questions.answer: Have you heard the news about Ken yet? / Yes, I have. I heard it yesterday.

practice.title: B — About you
practice.instruction: Answer these questions with short answers or full sentences. 用简短回答或完整句子来回答以下问题。
practice.translation: Answer each question with a short answer or a full sentence about yourself.
practice.context: Open-ended personal questions; suggested model answers.

questions.prompt: 1. Have you read an English book yet?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I read it last week.

questions.prompt: 2. Have you ever had a crash on your bicycle (or in a car)?
questions.answer: No, I haven't.

questions.prompt: 3. Have you ever been to the U.S.A. or to the U.K.?
questions.answer: No, I haven't.

questions.prompt: 4. Which foreign country or countries have you been to?
questions.answer: I've been to Japan.

questions.prompt: 5. Have you watched television today?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I watched it this morning.

questions.prompt: 6. Have you finished your homework yet?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I finished it half an hour ago.

grammar.title: I. Give correct replies to the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句写出下列各句的对应句。
grammar.instruction:
Give correct replies to the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句写出下列各句的对应句。
Example: 1. Close the window, please. → Yes, of course. Now I've closed it.
grammar.translation: Give a present-perfect reply to each imperative, following the example.
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are suggested model answers following the example (the grammar key pages in the PDF cover only Lesson 87).

questions.prompt: 1. Close the window, please.
questions.answer: Yes, of course. Now I've closed it.

questions.prompt: 2. Open the door, please.
questions.answer: Yes, of course. Now I've opened it.

questions.prompt: 3. Sweep the floor, please.
questions.answer: Yes, of course. Now I've swept it.

questions.prompt: 4. Clean the blackboard, please.
questions.answer: Yes, of course. Now I've cleaned it.

questions.prompt: 5. Dust the dressing table, please.
questions.answer: Yes, of course. Now I've dusted it.

questions.prompt: 6. Sharpen the pencils, please.
questions.answer: Yes, of course. Now I've sharpened them.

questions.prompt: 7. Wash the dishes, please.
questions.answer: Yes, of course. Now I've washed them.

questions.prompt: 8. Make the tea, please.
questions.answer: Yes, of course. Now I've made it.

questions.prompt: 9. Type the letter for me, please.
questions.answer: Yes, of course. Now I've typed it.

questions.prompt: 10. Give the books to Ann, please.
questions.answer: Yes, of course. Now I've given them to Ann.

grammar.title: II. Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.instruction:
Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
Example: 1. Have you met Ann and Jane yet? → I've met Ann, but I haven't met Jane yet.
grammar.translation: Answer each 'and' question with a present-perfect positive and a present-perfect negative for the second part, following the example.
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are suggested model answers following the example (the grammar key pages in the PDF cover only Lesson 87).

questions.prompt: 1. Have you met Ann and Jane yet?
questions.answer: I've met Ann, but I haven't met Jane yet.

questions.prompt: 2. Have you had beef and potatoes yet?
questions.answer: I've had beef, but I haven't had potatoes yet.

questions.prompt: 3. Has she bought envelopes and stamps yet?
questions.answer: She's bought envelopes, but she hasn't bought stamps yet.

questions.prompt: 4. Has he found the keys and the money yet?
questions.answer: He's found the keys, but he hasn't found the money yet.

questions.prompt: 5. Have they sold their house and car yet?
questions.answer: They've sold their house, but they haven't sold their car yet.

questions.prompt: 6. Has the cat had its fish and milk yet?
questions.answer: The cat has had its fish, but it hasn't had its milk yet.

questions.prompt: 7. Have you had the medicine for your cold and headache yet?
questions.answer: I've had the medicine for my cold, but I haven't had the medicine for my headache yet.

questions.prompt: 8. Has he put on his suit and tie yet?
questions.answer: He's put on his suit, but he hasn't put on his tie yet.

questions.prompt: 9. Have they turned off the television and the stereo yet?
questions.answer: They've turned off the television, but they haven't turned off the stereo yet.

questions.prompt: 10. Has she typed a letter to her parents and one to her teacher yet?
questions.answer: She's typed a letter to her parents, but she hasn't typed one to her teacher yet.
